analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 49.0 maintains neutral territory, MACD histogram at -179.9101 continues weak convergence. Despite 5 consecutive daily closes in the green, price remains below SMA20 ($33,513) resistance and swing resistance ($34,850). ADX at 28.7 indicates a trend, but +DI (24.7) is below -DI (33.0), suggesting downward pressure dominance. With ATR at $1,913, setting a stop loss at 1.3x ATR ($2,487) allows for a target of $35,142 to achieve a 1.5 risk-reward ratio, but confirmation of resistance breakout is needed.
